companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: Let’s turn visions into reality. At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our areas of activity are every bit as diverse as our outstanding Bosch teams around the world. Their creativity is the key to innovation through connected living, mobility or industry. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: we grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Join in and feel the difference.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
As Logistics Section Manager, you will lead the end-to-end planning activities of an assigned value stream, ensuring superior customer delivery performance while balancing inventory, capacity, and operational efficiency.

You will be responsible for managing and developing teams covering Demand Planning, Production Planning, and Material Planning. Acting as a key business partner across Sales, Production, Purchasing, Engineering, and Logistics, you will transform customer demand into reliable and executable supply chain plans.

The role requires a strong end-to-end supply chain mindset, combining strategic planning, operational excellence, people leadership, and continuous improvement. This is in line with Bosch Logistics’ integrated planning approach, where demand, material, and production planning are managed as one connected process chain.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Logistics, Demand, Production, or Material Planning.

  • Proven manufacturing experience and team leadership.

  • Strong track record of operational improvement and business results.

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Demand, Production, and Material Planning, Inventory Management, MRP, Capacity Planning, and S&OP / Integrated Business Planning.

  • Advanced SAP knowledge; Power BI and data analytics experience is an advantage.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and influencing skills.

  • Strategic mindset with hands-on execution capability.

  • Ability to manage pressure, ambiguity, and complex stakeholders.

  • Fluent English; German is an advantage.

Preferred Candidate Profile:

  • Demonstrates strong end-to-end supply chain thinking.

  • Has experience improving customer delivery and supply continuity.

  • Can balance customer requirements, capacity, inventory, and business objectives.

  • Combines strong people leadership with a data-driven mindset.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop planners across Demand, Production, and Material Planning.

  • Build a high-performance, customer-focused team culture.

  • Develop planning capabilities and support talent and succession planning.

  • Promote cross-functional collaboration.

  • Translate customer demand into feasible and reliable supply plans.

  • Drive forecast quality, demand transparency, and planning stability.

  • Balance demand, capacity, materials, inventory, and customer requirements.

  • Manage supply risks, shortages, bottlenecks, and recovery actions.

  • Optimize planning parameters, inventory levels, and replenishment strategies.

  • Monitor and improve key KPIs,
